name: Museo de Catanduanes
description: Museo de Catanduanes is a local museum in Virac that showcases the history, culture, and heritage of Catanduanes.

name: Puraran Beach
description: Puraran Beach in Baras is a beach known for surfing.

name: Marilima Beach
description: Marilima Beach is a white-sand beach in Barangay Marilima, Virac.
how_to_get_there: From Virac town, take a tricycle to Barangay Marilima.

name: Binurong Point
description: Binurong Point is a clifftop viewpoint in Baras with panoramic views of the Catanduanes coast.

name: Maribina Falls
description: Maribina Falls is a freshwater waterfall in Bato, in the barangays of Marinawa and Binanwahan, where visitors can swim.
how_to_get_there: About a kilometer from the main highway between Virac and Bato, reached on foot or by tricycle.
